# Junaid As (Junaid A S)

> AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer specializing in web & mobile apps, LLM integrations, and custom database pipelines.

## Main Navigation
- [Home Page](https://junaidas.in/): Core portfolio, skills, experience, and contact form.
- [Articles](https://junaidas.in/articles): Technical writeups on database optimization, AI pos systems, and full-stack architecture.
- [Contact Page](https://junaidas.in/contact): Direct form interface to connect with Junaid.

## Selected Work
- [SayBill AI](https://junaidas.in/projects/saybill): An AI-powered voice billing and retail POS ecosystem built with Flutter, Dart, CodeIgniter, and LLMs. It features custom natural language processing (NLP) cart inputs and a mobile barcode scanner.
- [ERMS](https://junaidas.in/projects/erms): Educational Resource Management System for performance tracking and automated reporting. Built with Flask, SQLYOG, Bootstrap, and custom composite relational database indexing.

## Technical Writing & Guides
- [Scale & Analytics: Architectural Design of ERMS](https://junaidas.in/articles/erms-database-architecture): Deep dive into Flask connection pooling, SQLAlchemy connection pool cycling, MySQL compound indexing, and database analytic window functions.
- [Voice-First POS with Flutter & LLMs](https://junaidas.in/articles/saybill-voice-pos): Details on background audio isolates in Dart, WebSocket streaming pipelines, and instruction-tuned LLM JSON schema extraction.
